description: The control-center dashboard overhaul (design Part A), the business-table wiring on ApplicationController create/store (Part B data-flow), the Renewal Reminder computation (Part D, read-only over permit.valid_until, NO application_type column), and the one-line Treasurer payment-flash fix (section 6.3). Depends on FEAT-001 for the config keys, nav items, and routes the dashboard links to. Covers cc-design.md sections 2, 3.1, 5, 6.3.
steps: app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/ApplicationController.php: add use Illuminate\Http\Request; and use App\Models\Business;. Change create() to create(Request $request): View — build a plain (object) prefill keyed with APPLICATION field names mapped from the user's oldest Business (business_name<-name, business_address<-address, business_nature<-nature; barangay/ownership_type/dti_sec_type/dti_sec_number same-named; number_of_employees ?? 0) plus applicant_name/contact_number/email from the User; null when the user has no business; return ['requirementTypes' => ..., 'application' => $prefill] (KEEP requirementTypes).

app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/ApplicationController.php store(): build the Application in memory (fill validated, associate user, status DRAFT), then inside a try/catch: $business = $user->businesses()->oldest()->first(); if none, new Business filled with Business-named fields mapped from validated Application data (name<-business_name, address<-business_address, nature<-business_nature, the rest same-named, number_of_employees ?? 0), $business->user()->associate($user), $business->save(); then $application->business()->associate($business). report($e) and swallow on any throw. $application->save() runs LAST, unconditionally. Never overwrite an existing business from an application edit.
resources/views/applicant/create.blade.php: change the include from ['application' => null] to ['application' => $application ?? null].

app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/DashboardController.php: keep the non-applicant redirect and the mark-all-read side effect. Change the applications query to ->with(['requirements.requirementType','payments','permit','remarks'])->latest()->get(). Build $stats from status: total, pending (SUBMITTED+UNDER_REVIEW), approved (PERMIT_RELEASED), action (FOR_CORRECTION+APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT), released, paymentPending, paymentVerified, draft, rejected. Do NOT call FeeComputationService eagerly. Compute renewalReminders as a collection of ['application','permit','daysLeft','expired'] for ACTIVE permits only (skip REVOKED and null valid_until): $daysLeft = (int) floor(Carbon::now()->startOfDay()->diffInDays($permit->valid_until->copy()->startOfDay(), false)); $expired = $daysLeft < 0; include when $daysLeft <= config('permit.renewal.reminder_days', 30). Pass applications, notifications, unreadCount (unchanged) plus stats and renewalReminders. Add use Carbon\Carbon; and use App\Models\Application; as needed.

resources/views/applicant/dashboard.blade.php: rebuild keeping @extends('layouts.app') and the .welcome-banner verbatim. IA: (1) welcome banner; (2) renewal banner(s) — amber .alert per renewalReminders entry, 'expires in {{ $daysLeft }} day(s)' when !expired else 'expired {{ abs($daysLeft) }} day(s) ago', link to applications.create, only when non-empty; (3) four callout blocks each rendered only when its status set is non-empty — Action needed (FOR_CORRECTION -> alert-warning showing latest remarks->where('type','CORRECTION')->sortByDesc('created_at')->first()?->body, link applications.edit; APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT -> alert-info, link applications.pay), Payment being verified (PAYMENT_PENDING, alert-info, actor word 'Treasurer', optional link applications.payments), Permit being prepared (PAYMENT_VERIFIED, alert-info, 'BPLO is preparing'), Good news (PERMIT_RELEASED -> alert-success, link applications.permit); (4) four <x-stat-card> (Total=default, Pending=amber, Approved=green, Action=red; pass integers only); (5) per-application .card list; (6) kept My Applications table (Tracking No. in <strong>, Edit only for DRAFT/FOR_CORRECTION, View always); (7) kept notifications list (latest 20, <x-empty-state> when empty). <x-empty-state> with a New Application CTA when there are no applications.

dashboard.blade.php per-application card: header (business name + prominent Tracking No. or '—' + <x-status-badge :status> + 'View details' -> applications.show); <x-process-tracker :application viewer="applicant" />; requirements summary (counts from checklist_status via ApplicationRequirement::CHECK_COMPLETE/CHECK_MISSING/CHECK_FOR_CORRECTION, show correction_note for FOR_CORRECTION rows); fee summary per the LOCKED rule below; permit card ONLY when status===PERMIT_RELEASED AND $application->permit is non-null (permit number, issued_at, valid_until, Download -> applications.permit.download, View QR -> applications.permit).

dashboard.blade.php fee-summary rule (LOCKED): in an @php block use $order = [STATUS_DRAFT,STATUS_SUBMITTED,STATUS_UNDER_REVIEW,STATUS_FOR_CORRECTION,STATUS_APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT,STATUS_PAYMENT_PENDING,STATUS_PAYMENT_VERIFIED,STATUS_PERMIT_RELEASED] (REJECTED deliberately absent); $idx = array_search($application->status, $order, true); $showFees = $idx !== false && $idx >= array_search(STATUS_APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT, $order, true). $current = $application->payments->sortByDesc('id')->first(). If status===APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT: ALWAYS link to applications.pay (re-payment case), show 'Assessment ready - view fees', NO peso amount; if $current is Payment::STATUS_FAILED with a rejection_reason, also show it in an alert-warning. If status in {PAYMENT_PENDING,PAYMENT_VERIFIED,PERMIT_RELEASED}: show $current->amount (formatted peso) + a status chip from $current, link to applications.payments. Any 'awaiting verification' wording uses 'Treasurer'. Never render fees for DRAFT/SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIEW/FOR_CORRECTION/REJECTED.

app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/PaymentController.php start(): change ONLY the manual-mode success flash from 'Payment details submitted. The BPLO will check your payment and confirm it. You will be notified once it is verified.' to 'Payment details submitted. The Treasurer will verify your GCash payment and confirm it. You will be notified once it is verified.' Leave the non-manual branch and all logic unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The applicant dashboard renders four stat cards, status-set callouts (incl. the Treasurer 'payment being verified' callout), a renewal banner only for near-expiry/expired ACTIVE permits, per-application cards with the process tracker, and the kept table + notifications — all via existing components, no invented status labels.

Fee amounts never appear for DRAFT/SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIEW/FOR_CORRECTION/REJECTED; APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT links to applications.pay even when a prior FAILED payment exists; permit/QR links appear only when PERMIT_RELEASED with a non-null permit relation.

Creating a new application links business_id and upserts a Business when the user has none, with user_id set via associate; an upsert failure never blocks application creation (business_id stays null); existing business_id-null applications still work.
The manual GCash start() flash names the Treasurer and not the BPLO.
php artisan test stays GREEN including tests/Feature/Applicant/ApplicationFlowTest.php (happy path + resubmit-keeps-tracking-number).
verification: Run with cwd "c:\\Users\\HP\\BUSINESS PERMIT_SYSTEM\\app": php artisan test tests/Feature/Applicant/ApplicationFlowTest.php — passes (store wiring did not regress).
php artisan test — full suite GREEN, baseline preserved.
findings: Implemented Part A/B/D + the 6.3 flash fix. ApplicationController: added use Illuminate\Http\Request and use App\Models\Business; create(Request) now builds an Application-field-named (object) prefill from the user's oldest Business (name->business_name, address->business_address, nature->business_nature; barangay/ownership_type/dti_sec_type/dti_sec_number same-named; number_of_employees ?? 0) plus applicant_name/contact_number/email from User, null when no business, and still returns requirementTypes. store() builds the Application in memory (fill validated, associate user, DRAFT), then in a try/catch find-or-create the oldest Business (user_id via associate(), never mass-assigned), associate it, report()+swallow on throw, and $application->save() runs LAST unconditionally so business_id stays null on failure and existing null-business flows are unaffected. create.blade.php include now passes ['application' => $application ?? null]. DashboardController: eager-loads requirements.requirementType, payments, permit, remarks; builds the 9-key status-derived $stats (total/pending/approved/action/released/paymentPending/paymentVerified/draft/rejected); computes renewalReminders over ACTIVE, non-null-valid_until permits using (int) floor(Carbon::now()->startOfDay()->diffInDays(valid_until->copy()->startOfDay(), false)), expired = daysLeft<0, included when daysLeft<=config('permit.renewal.reminder_days',30); does NOT call FeeComputationService eagerly; keeps the non-applicant redirect and mark-all-read side effect. dashboard.blade.php rebuilt: welcome banner verbatim, renewal banner(s), four status-set callouts (Action needed, Payment being verified=Treasurer, Permit being prepared=BPLO, Good news), four <x-stat-card>, per-application cards (header + prominent tracking no + status-badge + View details, <x-process-tracker viewer=applicant>, requirements summary via CHECK_* constants with correction_note, LOCKED fee guard, permit card gated on PERMIT_RELEASED && non-null permit), kept My Applications table (tracking no in <strong>, Edit only for DRAFT/FOR_CORRECTION) and notifications list, with <x-empty-state> CTAs when empty. Fee guard uses the 8-status $order (REJECTED absent), $idx !== false && $idx >= APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT index; $current = payments->sortByDesc('id')->first(); APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT ALWAYS links to applications.pay with no peso amount and surfaces a FAILED $current->rejection_reason in an alert-warning; PAYMENT_PENDING/VERIFIED/RELEASED show $current->amount + chip linking to applications.payments; never rendered for DRAFT/SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIEW/FOR_CORRECTION/REJECTED. PaymentController@start manual flash changed BPLO->Treasurer wording only. FEAT-001 artifacts (routes, config renewal/support blocks, nav imports) were already present. Verification: php artisan test tests/Feature/Applicant/ApplicationFlowTest.php + tests/Feature/Payment/ManualPaymentTest.php = 13 passed/78 assertions; full php artisan test = 154 passed/519 assertions GREEN; php artisan view:cache compiled the rebuilt dashboard with no Blade errors. No new tests were added for FEAT-002 (its verification references existing regression tests only); the brief's new-backend tests belong to FEAT-003/004 (Business Profile/Settings/Help/Renewal).
